title: CI draft-PR gates in .github/workflows: a Copilot-authored draft PR is gated like any other draft, so gate only on pull_request.draft == false
answers: Why are my Copilot-authored draft PRs no longer running CI jobs like master, lint, js or docs?
Which workflows gate heavy jobs on draft status, and what is the draft condition for a pull_request event?
Can I make a Copilot bot PR run gated jobs even while it is still a draft?
Where is the draft check for the build-wheel, examples, r or release-note workflows?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/*.yml job-level `if:` conditions (build-wheel, cross-version-tests, docs, examples, fs2db, js, labeling, lint, master, patch, protobuf-cross-test, protos, r, release-note, slow-tests, test-requirements, tracing, typescript, uc-oss, ui-preview) decide whether a pull_request event starts the job; the draft check is the gate.
Rule: The draft gate is `github.event.pull_request.draft == false`, with no author exception. Non-PR events keep their own branch, e.g. `github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.draft == false`. The earlier `|| (github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'Copilot' && github.event.pull_request.user.type == 'Bot')` clause was removed from these draft gates, so a Copilot-authored draft skips the same jobs as a human draft.
Constraints: This changes only the draft gate. Author-based authorization that is separate from draft status stays: ui-preview.yml still allows the Copilot bot in the `(contains(fromJSON('["OWNER", "MEMBER", "COLLABORATOR"]'), author_association) || (user.login == 'Copilot' && user.type == 'Bot'))` clause. Event triggers and paths-ignore lists are unchanged. Once a Copilot PR is marked ready for review (draft == false) the jobs run as for any PR. Pushes and scheduled or dispatch runs are not affected because the `event_name != 'pull_request'` branch is kept.
Applies: Draft-status gating of pull_request jobs in GitHub Actions workflows under .github/workflows; scope is the draft check only, not the Copilot authorization checks used for other purposes.

says: Draft pull requests created by the automated coding assistant are not triggering test suites.
Stop bot-generated draft pull requests from running expensive test pipelines before review.
Make automated assistant pull requests follow the standard draft gating rules as human contributors.
Why do build and lint workflows skip running on newly opened draft pull requests?
search: In .github/workflows, job-level draft gates for pull_request events must check pull_request.draft == false without exceptions for Copilot bot authors. Removing user.login == 'Copilot' clauses ensures bot-authored draft pull requests skip heavy jobs like master, lint, and build-wheel until marked ready for review. This policy applies strictly to pull request draft gating across workflows, leaving author-based permissions in ui-preview.yml, paths-ignore filters, and non-pull_request triggers intact.
